facts.fact: KRYSTE 没在 8:30 出现在 Oriental Hotel 大堂，到 10:00 KRAY 已经喝掉两杯 250 泰铢的咖啡。
facts.anchor: He missed his scheduled 8:30 a.m. appearance in the lobby of Bangkok’s posh Oriental Hotel. It was now 10:00, and KRAY had gone through two 250-baht cups of coffee.

facts.fact: 泰国职员告诉 KRAY，要找 Mr. Hank 大概可以去 Patpong Soi 1 的 Madrid Bar。
facts.anchor: you can probably find him at the Madrid Bar, Patpong Soi 1.

facts.fact: KRAY 给职员 400 泰铢，同时把食指竖在唇边示意他保密。
facts.anchor: KRAY handed him 400 baht while holding an index finger to his lips

facts.fact: KRYSTE 说那张褪色五十美元是 1968 年 1 月他开赴 Khe Sanh 收集情报时 BUTTONFLY 给他的。
facts.anchor: BUTTONFLY gave it to me when I shipped out to Khe Sanh to collect intelligence in January of ’68

facts.fact: Jim Thompson 的宅子其实是六座房子拼成的一座。
facts.anchor: Jim Thompson’s House was in reality six houses joined into one.

facts.fact: Thompson 于 1948 年加入 CIA。
医生查出 Thompson 患了严重的肝癌，已经到了晚期。
facts.anchor: He had a nasty liver cancer, pretty far gone.

facts.fact: 1967 年复活节星期日，Thompson 在马来西亚 Cameron Highlands 快步散步时失踪。
facts.anchor: So anyway, here’s what happened to Jim Thompson when he disappeared in Malaysia on Easter Sunday, 1967, during a brisk walkabout in the Cameron Highlands.
